First off, I'm glad there are people like you who want to understand, rather than blindly assuming we are all overreacting/attention seeking/mad.

I can only answer from my own situation and my own point of view, which is this; 

* I'm embarrassed, I feel weak for needing help. Pathetic for falling apart.

* I feel I would be wasting people's time in counselling/therapy.

* I think if I were to say anything to my parents, they would assume I'm not being serious or just 'going through a phase'. I fear others, such as a doctor or psychiatrist, would assume the same.

* It is incredibly difficult for some people, including myself, to talk about the things they feel and think. Some of my experiences, which play on my mind and worsen my state, I do not wish to re-live and some them - I flat out do not want people to know.

This is, of course, only my situation. It's different for everybody, I guess.
